tickets.title: A bad role file is skipped, not fatal
tickets.what:
`roleRegistry` (`src/roles/roster.ts`) stops throwing `invalid_role` for one bad file. A file that
fails validation (bad JSON, unknown harness, missing keys, wrong types) is left out of the roles and returned in an
`invalid` list `{ path, reason }`. `hud_roster` shows that list; `hud_create` for a role that exists only as an invalid
file answers `unknown_role` naming the file. The Project tab's control plane lists invalid files with their reason.
This also stops an older MCP from losing every tool when a newer harness kind's role file appears.

acceptance.text: One bad file in `$HUD_HOME/roles` leaves every other role and tool working
`hud_roster` lists `invalid: [{ path, reason }]`; reason is short and has no file contents
Project tab control plane shows invalid files (fixtures updated)
Unit tests for each reason class

comments.text: resolved in fca81428 (0.1.2). Tests: tests/unit/roster-invalid.test.mjs, project-page fixtures.

tickets.title: A set-up project's own roles, hidden roles and convention
tickets.what:
a project the owner set up is recorded in `$HUD_HOME/projects.json`
(`{ "version": 1, "projects": [{ "root": "/abs", "registered_at": "..." }] }`). For a registered project (root = git
top level of the cwd, else the cwd, realpath), `roleRegistry` also reads `<root>/.hud/roles/*.json` after
`$HUD_HOME/roles` (project wins by name); project role files must be `harness: "pi"` (others are invalid, as in 01).
When `<root>/.hud/project.json` lists `roles`, only those roles exist for that project. The convention lookup puts
`<root>/.hud/hud-convention.md` first. `hud_create` resolves against the job's `cwd`; `hud_roster` takes an optional
`cwd` (default: the server's cwd). An unregistered directory's `.hud/` is ignored and `hud_roster` says
`project_config_ignored: <root>`. The Project tab shows the same roster as `hud_roster` for its project.

acceptance.text: Registered project: project roles added/overriding, unlisted roles hidden, project convention used
Unregistered project with `.hud/`: nothing from it loads; roster says so
Non-pi project role file is invalid, not loaded
Unit tests on synthetic HUD_HOME and project dirs

tickets.what:

tickets.title: `hud setup --apply PLAN` and `--remove`
tickets.what:
`hud setup --apply PLAN.json [--cwd DIR]` writes a project's `.hud/` from a plan:
`{ "version": 1, "roles": [names enabled], "pi_roles": { "<name>": { "from"?: "<reference role>", "pi_role"?,
"model"?, "thinking"?, "split"?, "can_continue"?, "skills"?: [names] } }, "skills": { "<name>": "/abs/skill/dir" },
"agents": { "<role>": "<markdown>" }, "convention": "keep" | "copy-default" }`. It writes `.hud/project.json`
(roles, links it made), `.hud/roles/<name>.json` only where the role differs from its reference, symlinks
`.hud/skills/<name>` → dir, `.hud/agents/<role>.md`, optionally `.hud/hud-convention.md` from the shipped one, and
registers the root in `$HUD_HOME/projects.json`. Prints what changed; the same plan again changes nothing. Never
replaces a file or link it did not make (reports and skips). `--remove` drops the registration only and leaves `.hud/`.

acceptance.text: Plan validated before any write; invalid plan writes nothing
Idempotent; foreign files/links never replaced
After apply, `--detect` and `hud_roster` show the plan's roles
Unit tests on synthetic dirs

tickets.title: Pi workers get their role's skills and worker prompt
tickets.what:
when `hud_create` dispatches a pi role from a registered project, each `skills` entry (a name under
`<root>/.hud/skills/`, or an absolute path) becomes `--skill <dir>` after pi-role's `--`, and an existing
`<root>/.hud/agents/<role>.md` becomes `--append-system-prompt <file>`. A broken link is skipped and named in the job's
record; it does not fail the launch. `hud_read` shows the skills and prompt file the job got. Other harnesses: no change.

acceptance.text: pi argv carries `--skill` per skill and `--append-system-prompt` when the file exists
Loading check without a model call (`PI_ROLE_DEBUG=exit`) lists the skill and the role section survives
Broken link skipped and recorded
Real pi job by the orchestrator in a set-up project
